name: Memphis
local_rules: Memphis requires a mandatory 'Not Guilty' plea for any parking ticket contest. The 201 Poplar Avenue address is the Criminal Justice Center; you must specify 'Room LL-80' on the envelope to ensure the appeal reaches the Traffic Violations Bureau. If you do not resolve the ticket within 30 days, the court treats silence as a default admission, which can trigger license holds under Tennessee state law. Always include a copy of the citation front and back. Private lots in the Beale Street area are managed by vendors like Premium Parking — the city clerk cannot dismiss those; verify the citation was issued by MPD or 'City of Memphis' before mailing.
